_doc: ElevenLabs text-to-sound prompts for the ids Freesound covers worst (magic, spirit, fanfares). gen_elevenlabs.py adds 'candidates' generations per id to staging/audio/sfx/<id>/ beside the Freesound ones. Every prompt ends in the shared style suffix. Durations in seconds; ElevenLabs bills per generated second.
style: fantasy action RPG game sound effect, clean, punchy, no music, no voice
